answer_1.quote: Recent years have witnessed the successful application of natural language generation. Many of the applications in fact require certain degree of personalization, such as explainable recommendation , review generation , review summarization , and conversational systems .

answer_2.quote: For the former, we adopt BLEU  in machine translation and ROUGE ) in text summarization, and report BLEU-1 and BLEU-4, and Precision, Recall and F1 of ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2. ... we adopt USR that computes the Unique Sentence Ratio of generated sentences . ... we adopt the other three metrics proposed by : Feature Matching Ratio (FMR), Feature Coverage Ratio (FCR) and Feature Diversity (DIV).
